facts.text: si_get sends a JSON get for one server property and returns the reply's value
si_set sends a JSON set and asserts that the reply value equals the requested value
si_eval sends a Matlab eval string with a required number of outputs
si_feval sends a Matlab feval with inputs named in000, in001, ... and a required number of outputs
close closes the socket, and the class is a context manager whose exit closes it
Requests and replies are an 8-byte little-endian length followed by the JSON body
The client examples get and set the ScanImage property hSI.hRoiManager.scanZoomFactor
The example feval message names hSI.startFocus with an empty input map and num_outputs 0
The README says the client changes photostimulation power, adjusts imaging power and runs imaging series over a network socket
The README describes dummy_json_server.py as a Python fake of the Vidrio JsonServer that allows unit testing

operator_required.reason: no text of the clone states an allowed range for hSI.hRoiManager.scanZoomFactor: JsonClientTest.m:18-19 shows one example set value (10) and test_matlab_jsonserver.py:31 comments the setter out, so the site supplies the range of its ScanImage configuration

safe_state.description: control socket closed by the native close(); this client sends no further ScanImage command, while an acquisition already running on the ScanImage host is not stopped by it
